Engineering-level documentation on automotive battery technology, manufacturing, and testing.

- AGM Technology: https://technical.chengguangenergy.com/battery-technology/agm/
- EFB Technology: https://technical.chengguangenergy.com/battery-technology/efb/
- Heavy Duty: https://technical.chengguangenergy.com/battery-technology/heavy-duty/
- CCA Testing: https://technical.chengguangenergy.com/battery-testing/cca/

## Ecosystem

- [Main Site](https://chengguangenergy.com/): Factory, capabilities, certifications, contact
- [Battery Database](https://data.chengguangenergy.com/): Models, specifications, cross-reference
- [Technical Center](https://technical.chengguangenergy.com/): Technology, engineering, testing — **this site**
- [OEM Manufacturing](https://oem.chengguangenergy.com/): Private label, custom, OEM process
- [Market Intelligence](https://market.chengguangenergy.com/): Regional demand and market trends
- [Battery Tools](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/): Finders, calculators, cross-reference tools
